newsitem.title: USA: Empi CFO Timothy Briggs resigns.
newsitem.headline: Empi CFO Timothy Briggs resigns.

text.p: Empi Inc, a medical device manufacturer, said on Monday that Timothy Briggs has resigned as chief financial officer, effective February 28, in order to pursue alternate career objectives.
The company said it has begun a search to find a successor.
Empi also said that after months of field testing, it launched its new Relion iontophoresis product line for veterinary use.
Iontophoresis is a transdermal drug delivery process that uses electrical energy to facilitate delivery of ionic drug molecules through the skin without use of a needle.
The new Relion iontophoresis line was specifically developed for equine use.
